VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design to enhance the big-screen experience.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios announces Ghost of Tabor: Legacy, reviving the 2024 version of the game for Meta Quest and PC VR later this month.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple releases technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing developer options for the platform.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve teases the upcoming Steam Frame standalone headset with a new store page highlighting top games, but remains silent on pricing and release date.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack reiterates his $1 million guarantee to Microsoft to support Team Beef's VR ports of classic id Software games.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Squingle Arcade, a fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game featuring hand tracking, is now available for free on Meta Quest.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after receiving government approval, introducing 'ChatGPT Work' for organizational use.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature that labels ads created or edited with AI in its 'My Ad Center' for better transparency.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta disables a controversial Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts following backlash.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?

AI.title: Microsoft’s patch Tuesdays are about to get bigger

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility

NFL.title: Bears sign third-round TE Sam Roush to complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Bears have officially signed third-round tight end Sam Roush, completing their draft class signings.

NFL.title: Colts want to "find ways to take some of that workload" off Jonathan Taylor
NFL.summary: The Colts aim to reduce Jonathan Taylor's workload as they seek to manage his carries more effectively this season.

NFL.title: Report: George Pickens among teammates working with Dak Prescott in Utah
NFL.summary: George Pickens is reportedly training with Dak Prescott in Utah, despite skipping most of the Cowboys' offseason program.

NFL.title: NFL should be looking at FIFA's "Referee View"
NFL.summary: The NFL is considering adopting FIFA's 'Referee View' technology to enhance broadcast quality through AI-stabilized images.

NFL.title: ESPN places Matt Miller on leave
NFL.summary: ESPN places analyst Matt Miller on leave following a serious car accident and subsequent online complaints regarding his conduct.
